t: This is Hyde Park Place, a street in the Tyburnia district of the City of Westminster. One former resident was Sir Albert Gladstone, the fifth baronet. He was a British businessman and a rower, and he won a gold medal at the 1908 Summer Olympics. There isn't much more in the material I have about this street, so I'll leave it there. It's a quiet reminder that Tyburnia has housed people with some remarkable achievements behind them.
